Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000336": In the product catalog, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000332" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: product catalog, image metadata)
- memory_id "1000319": The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000268" [constraint]: The product catalog can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: product catalog)
- memory_id "1000156": The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents.  (about: product catalog, indexer)
- memory_id "1000110": The Cinder team owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder team, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000542": The Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000561" [decision]: As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Tomasz is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000533" [decision]: Diego is on call for the Cinder team this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000400" [decision]: The Cinder team adopted trunk-based development.  (about: Cinder team, trunk-based development)
- memory_id "1000237": From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000103" [decision]: Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000026": Diego is on the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Diego)
- memory_id "1000599" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000177" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000610" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000340" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000312" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000195" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
Existing entity names: product catalog, image metadata, image resizer, indexer, Cinder team, Ember team, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Yuki Tanaka, Diego, webhook dispatcher, the cache change, trunk-based development, Oskar, job scheduler, ledger service, the bus, billing API
